newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm on cash premium to futures.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm on cash premium to futures.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed quietly higher on cash rice prices' persistent strong premium to futures, traders said.
"The cash market continues to trade at a premium to futures and that's really why we stay firm in futures," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 100 lots, down from 199 Friday. Rice options volume was estimated at 20 contracts, up from 10 on Friday.
Rice futures closed unchanged to four cents per cwt higher, with September up four at $10.34 per cwt.
